fixes.rationale_full: FR-PROXY-001 AC-2 requires a host name, IPv4 literal or bracketed IPv6 literal and IllegalArgumentException otherwise; isHostName only checked the character set, so http://., http://-, http://a..b, http://_ etc. constructed a proxy. isHostName now requires one or more dot-separated labels via new isLabel (1..63 chars of ASCII letters/digits/'-'/'_', not starting or ending with '-', at least one letter or digit), total length (root dot excluded) 1..253, exactly one optional trailing root dot, no other empty label; the numeric-last-label rule (decimal or 0x last label => must be strict dotted-quad IPv4 via isIpv4 on the full string) is kept unchanged, so http://127.0.0.1.:8081 stays rejected and h1.example. stays accepted. Class javadoc updated to point at isHostName.
